question: How great a material offering is declared insufficient compared to this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels represents immense wealth.
Such wealth is compared to the value of the teaching.
inference: Even the accumulation of an ocean full of jewels is not an adequate equivalent for this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a difficult fused form; parsing is tentative
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
